author: Oraporo
body:
Not sure where to post it.. but i'll just post it here.

User:Oraporo
Why I was banned? I was banned for 3rd abuse of void logging. But the 3rd time I believe I never did it because I just logged off, then logged back on after the game ended and it said 'I have been banned' I might be wrong but that's what I remember. (It's been 4 months)
I believe I should be un-banned because, It's not like I was hacking or disrupting the game drastically, but I do understand the reason for me to be banned. Also I have grown out of those childish acts and would love to come back to this server to have fun and play fair.

-Thanks,
Oraporo
